parameters.help_en: The task configuration file. This parameter is required in professional mode
parameters.help_zh: 任务配置文件，专业模式必填
parameters.name: job_config

parameters.help_en: The name of the Kafka group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The fallback offset.

The FallbackOffset parameter defines the behavior when a consumer does not request a specific offset to consume, or when the requested offset exceeds the offset range recorded in the current Kafka cluster. You can choose to start consuming from the earliest or latest offset
parameters.help_zh:
FallbackOffset 回退点位，回退偏移量

FallbackOffset参数定义了当consumer没有请求需要消费的位点或者请求的消费的位点超出当前kafka集群的记录的位点信息的时候的行为。可以选择从earliest（最新）或者latest（最晚）位点开始消费
parameters.name: fallback_offset

parameters.help_en: The match columns. Typically, these are all the primary key columns of the destination table. If the values of all columns in this configuration are the same, the two rows of data are considered duplicate
parameters.help_zh: 匹配列，通常为目标表的所有主键列，此配置内所有列的值相同即视为两行数据为重复数据
parameters.name: match_columns

parameters.help_en: The update columns. Typically, these are all the non-primary key columns of the destination table. When duplicate data is identified based on MatchColumns, updating the values of the UpdateColumns overwrites the old data with the new data
parameters.help_zh: 更新列，通常为目标表的所有非主键列，当通过MatchColumns确定数据重复时，通过更新UpdateColumns列的值，产生使新数据覆盖旧数据的效果
parameters.name: update_columns

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of allowed error rows. When data in Kafka does not match the destination AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL table, a write failure occurs. If the number of error rows exceeds this value, the task fails
parameters.help_zh: kafka中的数据与adbpg目标表不匹配造时会造成写入失败，此值为允许错误行的行数，超出后会造成任务失败
parameters.name: error_limit_count

parameters.help_en: The delivery guarantee
parameters.name: consistency
